content.title: Configure your node
content.description: Declare a speed parameter and use its value in a timer-driven controller. A parameter belongs to one node. The browser runtime uses one numeric type; native ROS 2 distinguishes integer and double parameters.
steps: Declare speed = 0.2.
Read it inside a timer, clamp to 0–0.8, and publish /cmd_vel.
Inspect ros2 param list and ros2 param get /student_controller speed.
hints: A parameter belongs to its node. Declare its default once in the constructor.
Use declare_parameter<double>("speed", 0.2); read get_parameter("speed").as_double() inside the timer.
Clamp the value to 0.0–0.8 and assign it to command.linear.x before publishing.
